{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Identify the sentinel value
sentinel_value = sales_df['customer_age'].min()

# Replace sentinel value with NaN
sales_df_clean = sales_df.copy()
sales_df_clean['customer_age'] = sales_df_clean['customer_age'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Compute the mean age after removing sentinel values
mean_age_clean = sales_df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

# Verify the count of valid ages
valid_age_count = sales_df_clean['customer_age'].notna().sum()

mean_age_clean, valid_age_count"}
